notes.title: Announcing SHADOWS ON THE VATICAN - ACT III: SLOTH coming to PC in 2023
notes.content:
[b][previewyoutube=4KdMtI7z1j8;full][/previewyoutube][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072600/Shadows_on_the_Vatican__Act_III_Sloth/]WISHLIST THE GAME NOW![/url][/b]

To celebrate the first anniversary of its spinoff prequel [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182530/Shadows_on_the_Vatican_Nightingale/]Shadows on the Vatican: Nightingale[/url][/b], we are pleased to announce [b]SHADOWS ON THE VATICAN – ACT III: SLOTH[/b], the highly anticipated next full installment of our classic-styled point-and-click adventure series coming to PC on Steam in 2023.

Corruption dwells in the darkness at the highest levels of the Catholic Church, as a small but powerful cabal is covertly pulling the strings behind the most pivotal aspects of Italian society. In the penultimate act of the four-part religious conspiracy thriller set in Italy, ex-priest James Murphy and the paid assassin named Silvia must put aside their differences and join forces to expose the “Suits” before becoming their latest victims.

Alternating control between James and Silvia, players will explore a variety of beautifully illustrated locations across Rome, which look better than ever thanks to completely restyled hand-drawn graphics and redesigned animations.

And if you are still missing any of the games published so far, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8746/Shadows_on_the_Vatican__Series/]the series bundle is on sale[/url]!

notes.title: OFFICIAL ACT II SOUNDTRACK RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hi, 

we have just released the soundtracks for Shadows on the Vatican Act I and II as a FREE DLC for those who already owns the games. For the occasion we're offering the games at our maximum discount yet.

This serves also as a message for you guys: the series is very much alive, as will become obvious very soon.

notes.title: Nightingale released!
notes.content:
Binary Charm and Daring Touch are glad to announce that their new game, the text adventure [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182530/Nightingale?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Nightingale[/url], has been just released on Steam. The game is an independent, self-contained short-story set in the Shadows on the Vatican series narrative universe.
Here's the [url=https://www.nightingale-game.com]official website[/url].

In occasion of the event, both of the Shadows on the Vatican games are avalaible at their max discount yet! Check them out and complete the series!

ABOUT THE GAME:
Writing on a blog and using her obscure ability, the mysterious Nightingale has been helping people in danger for years. Now, she’s forced to disappear, facing threats from a killer... one of those people she helped in the past.

FEATURES:
— Available Languages: English, Italian
— About one hour of gameplay
— Original soundtrack
— Achievements
— Powered by INarEn story presentation and navigation

notes.title: NIGHTINGALE revealed!
notes.content:
We know that many of you are interested in the "health status" of Shadows on the Vatican.
We can tell you that the production of Act III is proceeding, with lots of news that we can't wait to share with you.

Meanwhile, as testament that the series is alive and well, we're about to publish NIGHTINGALE (release date: July 27), an interactive short story set in the SotV universe (recounting events that occurred two years before Act I).

The adventure goes deep into certain aspects of the series and, above all, provides some glimpses into what we are going to explore further in Act III and IV.

Don't forget to add it to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182530/Nightingale/]STEAM WISHLIST[/url]!

[url=https://www.nightingale-game.com/]OFFICIAL SITE[/url][previewyoutube=OMD2m0ap-zE;full][/previewyoutube]
